$comment: Development seed topology for the section 5.4 verification harness. This file holds NO credential: the five actor passwords live in the git-ignored .pi/api.json.local, referenced from .pi/api.json through auth.accounts_file. Accounts are matched to this file by email. Two businesses exist because section 5.4 requires more than one business and more than one branch: a cross-branch refusal inside one business must be distinguishable from a cross-business refusal.

memberships.$comment: OWNER is business-wide: branch null, equal access to every branch of B1. Refused on B2.
EMPLOYEE is branch-scoped to B1-CENTRAL. Refused on B1-NORTE (cross-branch, same business) and on B2 (cross-business).

platformActors.$comment: No membership and no branch context: account.platform_role, never a membership. Refused on operational data.

customers.$comment: PLAYER holds no membership: public browsing and own records only.

refusalMatrix.$comment: The cases this topology exists to make refusable.
